messages.text: What is signal-integrity-to-oscilloscope, and which product-related measurement decisions depend on understanding it?

### Short answer
The passages do not define a standalone term called “signal-integrity-to-oscilloscope”; they support it only as a measurement mapping in high-speed digital / SerDes / PCB-PCBA validation, where Signal Integrity is connected to oscilloscope-based interface testing and PDN-related scope measurements, alongside other instruments and SI methods such as IL, Xtalk, eye diagram and TDR impedance [1][2][19][54].
### What it means
“Signal-integrity-to-oscilloscope” is best understood as the link between Signal Integrity validation and oscilloscope use in the SerDes / SI / PI test context: Slide 11 maps Interface Test to scopes, BERTs, AWGs and switch matrices, and maps Power Distribution Network testing to scopes and network analyzers [1][2].  
The same source places Signal Integrity in the high-speed PCB/PCBA flow with IL / Xtalk / Eye diagram, TDR Impedance, Stackup Planner and TL Calculator, so the oscilloscope connection is part of a broader SI validation flow rather than a complete standalone product definition [1][2][71].  
### Product-related measurement decisions that depend on understanding it
| Measurement decision | What the passages support | Product / instrument implication | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| Whether an oscilloscope is part of Interface Test | Interface Test is mapped to scopes, BERTs, AWGs and switch matrices | A scope may be selected as one instrument type for high-speed electrical interface validation, but the passages do not give model, bandwidth, option or standard version | [1][2][19] |
| Whether a scope is relevant to PDN / PI work | Power Distribution Network is mapped to scopes and network analyzers | A scope is one possible PDN measurement instrument type, but the passages do not provide PDN impedance target values, method or product option | [1][2][3] |
| Whether eye diagram belongs in SI measurement planning | The SI flow lists IL / Xtalk / Eye diagram as part of high-speed PCB/PCBA signal integrity flow | Eye-diagram measurement is part of SI planning, but the passages do not specify oscilloscope model, software option or compliance setup | [1][2][3] |
| Whether TDR impedance is part of SI / PCB test planning | The SI flow lists TDR Impedance, and R&S PCB test solutions list Material Measurement with Impedance (TDR) | TDR / impedance decisions are part of PCB SI test planning, but no TDR option, probe, fixture or model is specified | [1][22][24][73] |
| Whether VNA products are relevant for SI channel measurements | R&S ZNA and R&S ZNB are mapped to PCB IL / TDR, connector / cable high-speed cable testing, and high-speed trace test contexts | For SI / interconnect work, ZNA / ZNB are mapped to IL, TDR, high-speed trace and high-speed cable needs, but the source does not give actual frequency range or fixture | [34][92] |
| Whether MXO is relevant to PI / power-rail measurements | MXO is listed for power rail, multiphase DC, PI and motor driver analysis | MXO-related decisions depend more on PI / power-rail needs than on the SI eye / channel flow, and no option or measurement condition is specified | [89] |
| Whether FSWP is relevant to jitter / phase-noise decisions | R&S FSWP is listed for LDO NSD test, clock jitter test, and jitter / phase noise test | FSWP-related decisions depend on clock jitter / phase-noise / LDO noise needs, not on oscilloscope SI alone, and the passages do not provide test conditions | [90] |
| Whether ZNL is relevant to PDN decisions | R&S ZNL is listed as a PDN Target Z line | ZNL-related decisions depend on PDN Target Z needs, but the passages do not provide setup, option or target impedance values | [34][89] |
### Key limitation
The passages explicitly say the Slide 11 and Slide 21 sources do not provide instrument models, software options, test standards, fixtures, calibration methods, test conditions, frequency ranges or formal product configurations for these mappings [3][21][73].

PCIe Gen5 high-speed PCB layout › Dk / Df 與 fiber weave skew
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 routing differential signals 時，每條 trace 會因 [[fiberglass weave]] 與 [[epoxy]] 的 static permittivity（εr）差異，而經歷不同 dielectric constants 與 signal velocities。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 fiberglass weave 的 εr 約為 6，epoxy 的 εr 約為 3。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 fiber glass laminate 中的 holes 或 openings 會造成 εr 與 loss tangent（Df）差異。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 εr 與 Df 差異會在 signal bandwidth 的不同頻率上造成 transmission media 的 [[return loss]] 或 [[insertion loss]] resonance / anti-resonance。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 differential pair 兩條 signal 若經過不同 fiberglass / epoxy 比例，會產生 [[intra-pair skew]]，並劣化 receiver 看到的 differential eye diagram。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 fiber weave skew 會造成 duty cycle distortion、AC common-mode voltage noise 與 EMI issues。

PCIe Gen5 high-speed PCB layout › Reference plane 與 vias
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 high-speed signal trace 從 origination 到 termination 必須全程維持相同 GND reference。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說若無法維持相同 GND reference，需 via-stitch 兩個 GND planes，以確保 continuous grounding 與 uniform impedance。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 stitching vias 應對稱放置於 signal transition vias 50 mils center-to-center 以內，越近越好。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 high-speed signals 必須 route over solid reference plane，除非絕對必要，不應跨越 plane split 或 reference plane void。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 TI 不建議 high-speed signal references 使用 power planes。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說若完全無法避免 routing over a plane-split，需在 split 兩側放置 stitching capacitors，提供 high-frequency current return path；stitching capacitors 必須為 1 µF 或更低，並盡可能靠近 plane crossing。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 vias 需要 staggered placement；aligned vias 會阻擋 current return path。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）建議 high-speed traces 只放在 top layer 或 bottom layer；若需要 vias，應考慮 back drilling，否則 stub length 可能降低 signal bandwidth。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 via transitions 造成的 stubs 若長於 15 mils，應 back-drill 以降低 insertion losses 並避免 resonance。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 PCIe Gen5 20/80% rise/fall time 為 12 ps；為保留 12 ps rise/fall time，需要約 29 GHz bandwidth（0.35/0.12 ns rule）。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說在 29 GHz bandwidth 且使用 Megtron 6（ε 約 3.4）時，quarter wavelength 約 54 mils；若未使用 back drilling，stub 必須小於約 54 mils；對 typical FR4（ε 約 4.2）PCB，maximum stub length 約 51 mils。

PCIe Gen5 high-speed PCB layout › Routing quick rules
[[snla426]]（June 2023）列出的 high-speed differential signal quick rules 包括：

- 不可在任何 high-speed differential signal 上放置 probe 或 test points。
- 不可將 high-speed traces route 在 crystals、oscillators、clock signal generators、switching power regulators、mounting holes、magnetic devices、board edge，或使用 / 複製 clock signals 的 ICs 下方或附近。
- BGA breakout 後，high-speed differential signals 應避開 PCIe device，因為 internal state transitions 產生的 high current transients 很難濾除。
- 盡可能將 high-speed differential pair signals route 在 PCB top layer 或 bottom layer，並搭配 adjacent GND layer。
- High-speed differential signals 與 reference plane edge 的距離需 ≥ 5×W 或 5×RPH，取較大者。
- High-speed differential signals 至少需距離 reference plane voids 4×RPH；此規則不適用於 high-speed differential signals 上 SMD pads 的 voiding。
- PCIe device BGA escape 後需維持 constant trace width，以避免 transmission lines 中的 impedance mismatches。
- 為改善 crosstalk，應遵循 ground-signal-ground signal routing，並將所有 high-speed differential pairs 對稱且平行地一起 routing。
- Package escape 與 routing 到 connector pins 時會自然偏離此要求，但 trace deviations 必須盡可能短，否則可能需要 trace width compensation。
- HFSS simulation 可用於最佳化 trace width。
- 多個 high-speed interfaces 的 devices 中，需避免不同 interfaces 間的 crosstalk。
- Package escape 後、connector termination 前，每個 differential pair 不應 route 在另一 differential pair 的 4–5×RPH mils 內。

### Short answer
The passages do not define a standalone term called “signal-integrity-to-oscilloscope”; they support it only as a measurement mapping in high-speed digital / SerDes / PCB-PCBA validation, where Signal Integrity is connected to oscilloscope-based interface testing and PDN-related scope measurements, alongside other instruments and SI methods such as IL, Xtalk, eye diagram and TDR impedance [1][2][19][54].
### What it means
“Signal-integrity-to-oscilloscope” is best understood as the link between Signal Integrity validation and oscilloscope use in the SerDes / SI / PI test context: Slide 11 maps Interface Test to scopes, BERTs, AWGs and switch matrices, and maps Power Distribution Network testing to scopes and network analyzers [1][2].  
The same source places Signal Integrity in the high-speed PCB/PCBA flow with IL / Xtalk / Eye diagram, TDR Impedance, Stackup Planner and TL Calculator, so the oscilloscope connection is part of a broader SI validation flow rather than a complete standalone product definition [1][2][71].  
### Product-related measurement decisions that depend on understanding it
| Measurement decision | What the passages support | Product / instrument implication | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| Whether an oscilloscope is part of Interface Test | Interface Test is mapped to scopes, BERTs, AWGs and switch matrices | A scope may be selected as one instrument type for high-speed electrical interface validation, but the passages do not give model, bandwidth, option or standard version | [1][2][19] |
| Whether a scope is relevant to PDN / PI work | Power Distribution Network is mapped to scopes and network analyzers | A scope is one possible PDN measurement instrument type, but the passages do not provide PDN impedance target values, method or product option | [1][2][3] |
| Whether eye diagram belongs in SI measurement planning | The SI flow lists IL / Xtalk / Eye diagram as part of high-speed PCB/PCBA signal integrity flow | Eye-diagram measurement is part of SI planning, but the passages do not specify oscilloscope model, software option or compliance setup | [1][2][3] |
| Whether TDR impedance is part of SI / PCB test planning | The SI flow lists TDR Impedance, and R&S PCB test solutions list Material Measurement with Impedance (TDR) | TDR / impedance decisions are part of PCB SI test planning, but no TDR option, probe, fixture or model is specified | [1][22][24][73] |
| Whether VNA products are relevant for SI channel measurements | R&S ZNA and R&S ZNB are mapped to PCB IL / TDR, connector / cable high-speed cable testing, and high-speed trace test contexts | For SI / interconnect work, ZNA / ZNB are mapped to IL, TDR, high-speed trace and high-speed cable needs, but the source does not give actual frequency range or fixture | [34][92] |
| Whether MXO is relevant to PI / power-rail measurements | MXO is listed for power rail, multiphase DC, PI and motor driver analysis | MXO-related decisions depend more on PI / power-rail needs than on the SI eye / channel flow, and no option or measurement condition is specified | [89] |
| Whether FSWP is relevant to jitter / phase-noise decisions | R&S FSWP is listed for LDO NSD test, clock jitter test, and jitter / phase noise test | FSWP-related decisions depend on clock jitter / phase-noise / LDO noise needs, not on oscilloscope SI alone, and the passages do not provide test conditions | [90] |
| Whether ZNL is relevant to PDN decisions | R&S ZNL is listed as a PDN Target Z line | ZNL-related decisions depend on PDN Target Z needs, but the passages do not provide setup, option or target impedance values | [34][89] |
### Key limitation
The passages explicitly say the Slide 11 and Slide 21 sources do not provide instrument models, software options, test standards, fixtures, calibration methods, test conditions, frequency ranges or formal product configurations for these mappings [3][21][73].
